jobs.title: Asset Protection Specialist — Security & Safety
jobs.description:
The Walmart Supercenter in Dallas, TX is seeking a security-focused team member to protect associates, customers and merchandise. You will investigate incidents, apply critical thinking and resolve security problems on a fast-paced retail unit.

This full-time role offers competitive hourly pay with incentives, a broad benefits package including health, retirement, time off, disability and education programs, and opportunities to advance within a nationwide retailer.
